notes.content:
Hey, folks. Steam's build review team ran into a weird rendering bug that made the game unplayable on certain hardware, and I found a couple more bugs. This release attempts to fix them.

[list]
[*] Made MSAA a setting, defaulting to 0 (FXAA is used when MSAA is 0)
[*] Added sheen to water edges
[*] Pointed feedback button to motorstripgames.com
[*] Fixed a bug that autosaved at the main menu
[/list]
